title: One introduced contact replied, two stayed silent: one card moves on, two stand

objects.subject: Arjun <> Sana Qadri (Driftwood)
objects.body:
Arjun, meet Sana Qadri, who runs finance at Driftwood and asked to see how Nimbus Labs keeps investor updates on time. Sana, meet Arjun Rao, the founder of Nimbus Labs, who is building an AI chief of staff for founders. Arjun, over to you. I'll let you two take it from here.

Introly

objects.subject: Arjun <> Omkar Joshi (Redfern Labs)
objects.body:
Arjun, meet Omkar Joshi, the CTO of Redfern Labs, who asked to compare notes on agent tooling. Omkar, meet Arjun Rao, the founder of Nimbus Labs, who is building an AI chief of staff for founders. Arjun, over to you. I'll let you two take it from here.

Introly

objects.subject: Arjun <> Tanvi Shah (Copperleaf)
objects.body:
Arjun, meet Tanvi Shah, who leads the founder programme at Copperleaf and asked whether Nimbus Labs would apply. Tanvi, meet Arjun Rao, the founder of Nimbus Labs, who is building an AI chief of staff for founders. Arjun, over to you. I'll let you two take it from here.

Introly

objects.subject: Re: Arjun <> Sana Qadri (Driftwood)
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

Nice to meet you. Could we do a short call on Wednesday at 2 pm? I'd like to see how you handle the monthly investor update.

Thanks,
Sana Qadri
Head of Finance, Driftwood
